# Draft:Easwari college technical clubs

= Technical Clubs at Easwari Engineering College =
Easwari Engineering College (EEC), a part of the SRM Group of Institutions, is home to a diverse array of student-led technical communities. These clubs aim to enhance students’ technological skills, foster peer learning, and prepare them for real-world innovation. Notable among these are the WiMax Community and Google Developer Student Club (GDSC EEC).
----
WiMax Community
The WiMax Community at Easwari Engineering College (EEC) is a student-led interdisciplinary technical club focused on wireless communication technologies, cloud systems, software development, and digital innovation. Named after WiMAX (Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access), the club symbolizes the pursuit of scalable and open connectivity—both technically and communally—within and beyond the campus.
----
Overview
Founded at: Easwari Engineering College, Chennai
Primary Focus Areas: Wireless Technologies, Open Source, Cloud Computing, Full-Stack Development, Community Projects
Active Platform: WiMax Community LinkedIn Page
Slogan: “Connect. Create. Collaborate.”
----
Mission and Vision
The WiMax Community exists to provide a platform for students to experiment with modern technology stacks, collaborate on innovative projects, and develop professional-grade technical skills. The club envisions fostering a generation of students who are capable of engineering solutions that are both scalable and impactful.
Core Goals:
* Promote awareness and hands-on experience with wireless and distributed systems
* Encourage student-led innovation through interdisciplinary projects
* Enable open learning via peer-to-peer mentorship and open-source collaboration

Key Activities and Initiatives
* Workshops & Webinars: Covering topics like wireless protocols, IoT, networking tools, cloud platforms, and app development
* Open Source Contributions: Training on Git/GitHub, collaborative coding, and contribution to community repositories
* Project Showcases: Students work on real-time tech solutions in areas like smart agriculture, energy monitoring, and campus automation
* Inter-Club Collaboration: Works closely with other EEC clubs like GDSC, AI/ML Club, and Cybersecurity Club
* Tech Talks and Expert Sessions: Industry speakers and alumni share trends in telecom, full-stack development, and tech careers
----
Community Engagement and Recognition
* Over 200+ active members across all departments
* Club posts and student achievements are regularly featured on LinkedIn
* Participated in national-level innovation challenges like Smart India Hackathon, Naan Mudhalvan, and IEEE events
* Contributed to inter-departmental tech initiatives and internal college software tools
----
Google Developer Student Club – Easwari Engineering College (GDSC EEC)
The Google Developer Student Club at Easwari Engineering College (GDSC EEC) is a student-led community supported by Google Developers, committed to helping students bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application in technology. GDSC EEC is part of a global initiative that empowers university students to build projects, develop technical skills, and impact their communities using Google technologies.
----
Overview
Founded at: Easwari Engineering College, Chennai
Affiliated to: Google Developers
Focus Areas: Cloud Computing, Machine Learning, Android Development, Web Development, Cybersecurity, UI/UX Design, Open Source
Official Hashtag: #GDSCEEC
Active Since: [Year club was established, if known]
----
Mission and Vision
GDSC EEC aims to foster a community of innovative thinkers, developers, and future tech leaders by creating learning opportunities, encouraging collaboration, and promoting inclusive peer-to-peer knowledge sharing.
Key Objectives:
* To provide a platform for students to learn, build, and connect
* To encourage project-based learning and community impact
* To promote the use of Google and open-source technologies
* To prepare students for real-world industry challenges
----
Core Activities
* Workshops & Bootcamps: On Android development, Firebase, Google Cloud, AI/ML, Web, and Cybersecurity
* Technical Sessions & Hackathons: Including Solution Challenge, Open Source Events, and DevFests
* Speaker Series & Mentorship: Interactions with Google Developer Experts and industry professionals
* Community Projects: Projects focused on solving real-life local or global issues, including those aligned with the UN SDGs
* Peer-to-Peer Learning: Encouraging collaborative projects and technical leadership
